The this project added a 0.6 mile multiuse trail1 along
SW 27th St, SW 40th Pl and SW 25th Ter connecting
Williston Rd to SW 35th Pl. The project was identified
as a regional priority in the Metropolitan
Transportation Planning Organization List of Priority
Projects as a key component in the trail system,
serving a dense populated area and providing
interconnectivity with transit by improving
accessibility to several bus stops along the corridors.
The project ties to the City's Strategic Plan Goal 3: A
Great Place to Live and Experience by promoting
safety and accessibility to a diverse population.
Funding was provided by a grant from the Florida
Department of Transportation2; project construction
was managed by the City’s Public Works Department.
Completion: January 2022
Total Cost: $638,390
Design by DRMP Inc.; Construction by ADEC, Inc.
1 Project plans available at gainesvillepublicworks.org
2 FDOT Project ID # 433989-1-38-02
